_comment: Regression seeds: failure patterns the eval has caught and that must not silently re-enter the codebase. Each entry references a case_id that already lives in golden.json (so the case is exercised by the standard eval run). This file is a SEMANTIC marker — run_evals.py does not yet load it. Wiring the loader is a deferred follow-up; until then, removal of these cases from golden.json without review must be caught manually. See plan: hidden-herding-manatee.md.

The judge ruled this misleading_fix_claim. The multi_part_complaint rule added to draft-response targets exactly this pattern.
